_comment: CoThink driver config. Roles 1 (Strategist) and 8 (Executor) are played by the conductor (Claude Code) natively; this file configures the engines for roles 2-7. Claude Code is the only entry point: it invokes the other CLIs, never the reverse.
_models_note: Empty string = the CLI's own default model (stays current). claude: pin a FULL id — unpinned calls land on whichever model each fleet account defaults to, and aliases resolve inconsistently. gemini: the Flash pin is a quota decision (the Antigravity weekly pool is small; one Pro-high Researcher run can lock the account out for days); use gemini-3.1-pro-high if quota is not a concern. codex: with a ChatGPT account the *-codex ids are rejected, so leave it empty. vibe: no --model flag; its model lives in ~/.vibe/config.toml.
_families_note: Model family per engine. The driver never lets the Analyst run on the family that actually wrote the code in this run (Coder or Fixer, including after fallbacks); it skips such engines and logs it.
_roles_note: engine = primary; fallbacks = ordered per-role chain tried when the primary fails (quota, crash, empty output); mode = read_only | plan | write. Builder/validator/tester are three different families (OpenAI / xAI / Moonshot) so no vendor both writes and judges the code; codex never appears in the Analyst or Tester chains. claude is used where one read-only call has the most leverage (Architect) and as the Analyst's first fallback — never in the write loop, which burns its quota fastest. vibe (Mistral, pay-per-token, 33% headless timeout rate observed) and qwen (pay-per-token, single-shot validator that fabricated evidence) are wired engines but kept out of the judgment seats.
_codex_reasoning_effort_note: Passed per call as `-c model_reasoning_effort=...` so cothink's Codex spend does not inherit an xhigh account default; the accounts' own config.toml is untouched. Empty = inherit.
_vibe_max_price_note: Hard USD cap per vibe (Mistral) call via --max-price; vibe is the only pay-per-token engine with a spend cap. Set to 0/null to disable.

durable_memory._comment: Optional: log run summaries/decisions to your OWN context-store REST API across runs. Off by default. Set base_url to your endpoint and export the bearer token in the env var named by token_env.
